appended_paragraphs: Original study: 18 October 2026. Report edition 1 prepared: 29 October 2026.
Anthony Siljeg - Founder, Alnotrea Labs. Company affiliation: Alnotrea Pty Ltd. Project: Q-Pathformer Initiative.

This edition retains the completed v0.1 study, all 15 tables, all three figures, numerical findings, uncertainty statements, limitations and research recommendations. It changes the internal-use cover, header and footer labels, records author and license metadata, and adds this edition note. No scientific result has been recalculated or omitted.

The recommendation in section 10 to treat the original report as an internal decision record is retained as a historical recommendation made on 18 October 2026. Its call for a separately registered confirmation study, qualified baselines, cost accounting and technical review remains a limitation on broader claims. Preparing this report edition is not evidence that those proposed studies have been completed.

The original frozen report and full experiment archive remain separately retained. This report edition does not include the AG News source dataset, trained checkpoints, full runtime environments or the complete reproduction archive. Historical local and archive-relative paths identify the original evidence, rather than download locations for the present report.
